description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Street Legal 6-Passenger Golf Cart Included* Two Lavish Living Spaces* Infinity Pool (seasonally heated) overlooking Gulf and Topsail State Park * Tennis courts, Nature Trails, and Fitness Center * 1 mile to Beach Highlands Neighborhood Beach Access* Close to Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place * Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* Welcome to Pineapple & Palms, a stunning 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath home nestled in the exclusive gated community of Cypress Dunes. This private retreat invites you into a serene and luxurious atmosphere from the moment you arrive. Inside, natural light floods the space, accentuating the elegant walnut hardwood floors and beautiful coastal decor. The sunroom offers a flexible space to enjoy your morning coffee, unwind with evening wine, or relax while watching TV. The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring stainless steel appliances and generous counter space. Let the local surroundings inspire your cooking, and serve up a fresh seafood feast at the charming farmhouse-style dining table. The first floor hosts a spacious king master bedroom, while the second floor boasts another king master bedroom and a guest bedroom with two queen beds, comfortably accommodating up to 8 guests. Step outside and enjoy the resort-style amenities that surround you, including an infinity pool, hot tub, tennis court, fitness center, nature trails, a lily pad-filled pond, and abundant wildlife. Pineapple & Palms is the perfect coastal retreat, offering an unforgettable beach getaway for family and friends for years to come!*Please note: As part of ongoing neighborhood improvements, there is currently construction nearby. Despite the hustle and bustle outside, your comfort remains our top priority. Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to hosting you!**Vehicles including pickup trucks with raised camper tops or other raised enclosures or commercial vehicles (including all vehicles with commercial lettering or logos), boats, trailers, large trucks, campers, jet skis, motorcycles, All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs), or similar vehicles are NOT PERMITTED in the Cypress Dunes community.**Wristbands need to worn at the Pool, Tennis Courts, and Clubhouse and Guests will be charged $100 for each lost Wristband. Please note that HOA only allows 2 wristbands per bedroom. Depending on bedroom and sleep counts some guests may need to share wristband*Along the west of 30A, just east of Miramar Beach, you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18 mile bike path that stretches all the way to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf and Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!The Bed Setup: 1st Floor Master Bedroom 1: King Bed 2nd Floor Master Bedroom 2: King Bed Guest Bedroom: Two Queen BedsArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
